tasks.goal: Build a product-specific responsive page from a written brief, including loading, empty and error states.
Improve an existing interface without changing its public behavior or data contract.
Implement validation, asynchronous failure recovery, keyboard use and focus management.
Build a dashboard whose charts, units and tables remain understandable on mobile and without animation.
Reproduce and fix a cross-file state bug while preserving unrelated behavior.
Reduce duplication and clarify component boundaries without changing behavior.
Add purposeful interruptible motion with cleanup, responsive behavior and reduced-motion support.
Integrate untrusted remote data without leaking secrets or introducing injection and authorization assumptions.
Build a factual hero and detail experience whose core objects are source-backed or procedurally validated, recognizable without labels and honestly represented at full size.
Preserve state, focus and cleanup through play-drag-reset, rapid tab changes, repeated modal use, storage failure and reduced-motion sequences.
